title: Record a voice message
summary: Records a voice message from the microphone button, with pause and resume, then a preview where the person checks the transcript made on this phone before sending (ADR 0023).

phase.description: recording and paused show the timer and the live waveform. preview shows the player and the transcript editor.

elapsedMs.description: Recorded length. Recording stops at 30 minutes.

transcriptState.description: Transcription on this phone only. unavailable: no on-device model for the language, or the speech permission is off.

transcript.description: The editable text. Empty means no transcript.

micDenied.description: The microphone permission is off. Shows bipe_microphone_permission_body.

start.effect: Asks for the microphone permission if needed, then records Ogg Opus, mono, and starts the on-device transcriber on the same audio.

resume.effect: Records again into the same message.

stop.effect: Ends recording and goes to preview. Less than 1 s: drops it and shows bipe_app_composer_too_short.

discard.effect: Deletes the recording and the transcript.

send.effect: Timeline.sendAttachment with AttachmentKind Voice (AudioInfo with the length and size, the waveform) and UploadParameters whose caption is the transcript when transcriptState is ready and the text is not blank. A transcript still transcribing is dropped; the sender never waits.

notes: Transcript rules (ADR 0023, audio.md phase 2): on this phone only, never a server fallback. Language: the first preferred language the phone transcribes offline, then pt-BR. The caption of a voice message is always a transcript; the app offers no other caption on voice.

Bipe logic: VoiceTranscriber.transcribe and VoiceTranscriptDraft (state transcribing, ready, unavailable; caption gives only a finished, non-empty text) (iOS); BipeVoiceTranscriber, AndroidBipeVoiceTranscriber, BipeVoiceTranscriptDraft and BipeVoiceTranscriptEditor (Android). Move them; do not write a new transcriber.
bipe_app_composer_limit takes the limit (30) formatted as minutes. The recording keeps what was recorded and goes to preview.
The send queue keeps the message when the network drops; the row shows sending, then sent or failed (read-receipts).
UploadParameters extra_content_json could carry the chat.bipe.audio field of audio.md; phase 1 does not use it (no schema in bipe-shared yet).
A setting to turn off transcription is not built (audio.md); the speech permission is the switch.
